description: A .NET client wrapper for the models.dev API.
releaseNotes:
# Changes since 0.2.0
This release fixes deserialization failures against the current models.dev payloads and maps fields that were previously missing. It also adds contract tests for `/api.json`, `/models.json`, and `/catalog.json`.

## Breaking changes
- `ModelInfoRepository` and `ModelMetadataRepository` now take `IModelsDevTransport`. Their constructors are `internal`. Resolve these repositories through dependency injection.
- `AIModelExperimental.Modes` now uses `Dictionary{string, AIModelExperimentalMode}` instead of `Dictionary{string, AIModelCostInfo}`. The old type interpreted each mode's nested `{cost, provider}` object as a cost and returned zero prices.
- This release removes `AIModelInfo.Modes`, `AIModelInfo.Headers`, `AIModelInfo.Body`, `AIProviderInfo.Description`, `AIModelMetadata.StructuredOutput`, `AIModelProviderOverride.Body`, and `AIModelProviderOverride.Headers`. These fields do not appear in the live payload.

## Added
- AOT-safe `JsonStringEnumConverter{TEnum}` registrations for `AIModelStatus`, `AIModelReasoningOptionType`, `AIModelProviderShape`, and `AIModelInterleavedField`.
- Mappings for `AIModelInfo.Limit`, `AIModelInfo.CanonicalModelId`, and `AIModelInfo.Type`.
- Mappings for `AIModelMetadata.Description`, `AIModelMetadata.License`, `AIModelMetadata.Links`, and `AIModelMetadata.Type`.
- `AIModelLinkInfo` for `/models.json` link entries (`label`, `url`, and `type`).
- `AIModelCostInfo.ReasoningCostPerMillionTokens`.
- `CacheReadPerMillionTokens`, `CacheWritePerMillionTokens`, and `ReasoningCostPerMillionTokens` on `AIModelCostTier`.
- `AIModelWeightInfo.Format` and `AIModelWeightInfo.Quantization`.
- `AIModelExperimentalMode` and `AIModelModeProvider` for the nested `{cost, provider}` shape.
- The internal `IModelsDevTransport` abstraction and `ModelsDevTransport` implementation. They handle HTTP client creation, GET requests, HTTP status validation, source-generated JSON decoding, and mapping null results to empty collections for `/api.json` and `/models.json`.
- `PayloadContractTests` for the JSON payload shapes of all three endpoints. `InternalsVisibleTo("ModelsDotDevSharp.Tests")` lets tests substitute the internal transport.

## Changed
- Model and provider lookups scan fetched arrays directly instead of using LINQ `First` or `FirstAsync`.
- `GetCatalogAsync` now throws `InvalidDataException` with the message "The models.dev API response body was empty or deserialized to null." when the response body is empty or deserializes to null.
- `CostContextOverridePostProcessor` now uses ordinal string comparison.
- Repository documentation now describes when endpoints return empty results and when they throw.
- Updated `Microsoft.Extensions.DependencyInjection.Abstractions`, `Microsoft.Extensions.Http`, and `Microsoft.Extensions.Options` from 10.0.12 to 11.0.0.
- Updated `TUnit` from 1.67.0 to 1.83.0.

## Fixed
- The `/api.json` and `/catalog.json` JSON contexts now handle string values for `status`, `reasoning_options`, `interleaved`, and `provider.shape`. Missing enum converters previously caused `JsonException` failures for the entire response.
- The `/api.json` path now resolves `context_over_*` extension data into typed `ContextOverrides`, matching `/catalog.json`. `GetProviderInfosAsync`, `GetProviderInfoByIdAsync`, and `EnumerateProviderInfosAsync` all use this processing.
- Collection endpoints return empty results when the response body is absent, null, or deserializes to null.

[Full changelog](https://github.com/alastairlundy/ModelsDotDevSharp/compare/0.2.0...0.3.0)
